title: stoa-imap: uidvalidity uses as-u32 cast — silent truncation after year 2106
description: mailbox.rs get_or_create_uidvalidity: uidvalidity = ...as_secs() as u32 silently truncates. After Unix ts exceeds u32::MAX (~year 2106) the value wraps to near-zero, violating RFC 3501 monotonicity requirement. Use try_from with a fallback.
